scripts.text:
[Festival Manager]
I am the festival NPC manager for the God SE quest.
Please enter your password.
scripts.translation:
[庆典管理员]
我是“神SE”任务的庆典NPC管理员。
请输入您的密码。

scripts.text:
[Festival Manager]
Password is incorrect.
scripts.translation:
[庆典管理员]
密码错误。

scripts.text:
[Festival Manager]
What would you like to do?
scripts.translation:
[庆典管理员]
您想要做什么？

scripts.text: Disable festival NPCs
scripts.translation: 禁用庆典NPC

scripts.text: Enable festival NPCs
scripts.translation: 启用庆典NPC

scripts.text:
[Festival Manager]
Ending festivals and disabling NPCs.
scripts.translation:
[庆典管理员]
正在结束庆典并禁用NPC。

scripts.text:
[Festival Manager]
Resetting festivals and enabling NPCs.
scripts.translation:
[庆典管理员]
正在重置庆典并启用NPC。

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
This is the flower.
This is just a formality, but let me check your qualifications.
scripts.translation:
[尔米米·拉维斯]
这是花儿。
这只是个形式，让我检查一下您的资格。

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
Your qualification is verified as a Guild master.
scripts.translation:
[尔米米·拉维斯]
已验证您的资格为公会会长。

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
I wonder if you know what this flower's use is... Let me explain it to you.
scripts.translation:
[尔米米·拉维斯]
不知道您是否知道这朵花的用途...让我为您解释一下。

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
This is the holy flower given by the Wish Maiden in Valkyrie, it can summon certain monsters by certain summoners.
scripts.translation:
[尔米米·拉维斯]
这是瓦尔基里赐予许愿少女的神圣之花，特定的召唤师可以使用它召唤特定的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
There are only two summoners in this world...
Me and my sister Rhehe...
scripts.translation:
[尔米米·拉维斯]
这个世界上只有两位召唤师...
我和我的妹妹蕾蕾...

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
We are totllly different, but we can...
scripts.translation:
[尔米米·拉维斯]
我们完全不同，但是我们可以...

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
Anyway,
Do you want to summon monsters?
scripts.translation:
[尔米米·拉维斯]
总之，
您想要召唤魔物吗？

scripts.text: Do not summon
scripts.translation: 不召唤

scripts.text: Summon, please
scripts.translation: 请召唤

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
I don't like to be interrupted by others..
scripts.translation:
[尔米米·拉维斯]
我不喜欢被别人打断...

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
But it's just business.
scripts.translation:
[尔米米·拉维斯]
但这只是公事。

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
I will explain to you how to summon monsters.
This flower can summon the monsters 'Valkyrie's Blessing' and 'Valkyrie's Present' for one hour here in Juno.
scripts.translation:
[尔米米·拉维斯]
我来向您解释如何召唤魔物。
这朵花可以在朱诺召唤“瓦尔基里的赐福”和“瓦尔基里的礼物”魔物，持续一小时。

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
An announcement will be made stating which monster is summoned.
This festival is given by the Wish maiden for all adventurers to enjoy all over the world.
scripts.translation:
[尔米米·拉维斯]
届时会发布公告，说明召唤的是哪种魔物。
这场节日是由许愿少女为全世界所有冒险者准备的。

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
Now, are you ready to summon monsters?
scripts.translation:
[尔米米·拉维斯]
那么，你准备好召唤魔物了吗？

scripts.text: No, I'm not ready now.
scripts.translation: 不，我现在还没准备好。

scripts.text: Yes! I'm ready for that.
scripts.translation: 是的！我准备好了。

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
If you are not ready, why did you come to me?
scripts.translation:
[尔米米·拉维斯]
如果你还没准备好，为什么还要来找我？

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
I'll be waiting until you are ready.
It is just business afterall.
scripts.translation:
[尔米米·拉维斯]
我会等你准备好的。
毕竟这只是公事。

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
Now we are ready.
scripts.translation:
[尔米米·拉维斯]
现在，我们准备好了。

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
Ok, we would ge started to summon monsters.
scripts.translation:
[尔米米·拉维斯]
好的，我们要开始召唤魔物了。

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
Have a good time.
scripts.translation:
[尔米米·拉维斯]
祝你玩得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
It seems that a Valkyrie's Blessing summoning ritual is already in progress elsewhere.
scripts.translation:
[尔米米·拉维斯]
似乎其他地方已经有人在进行“瓦尔基里的赐福”召唤仪式了。

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
Please try again later.
scripts.translation:
[尔米米·拉维斯]
请稍后再试。

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
It seems you are not worthy.
scripts.translation:
[尔米米·拉维斯]
看来你并不具备资格。

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
I don't know how you obtained that flower, but if you're not capable of leading others.. then you cannot continue.
scripts.translation:
[尔米米·拉维斯]
我不知道你是怎么得到那朵花的，但如果你没有能力领导他人...那你就无法继续了。

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
Too tough?
Well, what can you do, that's part of the job.
scripts.translation:
[尔米米·拉维斯]
太难了吗？
唉，没办法，这也是工作的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Rmimi Ravies]
Don't you have any voucher?
scripts.translation:
[尔米米·拉维斯]
你没有凭证吗？

scripts.text:
[Festival Manager]
I am the festival NPC manager for the God SE quest.
Please enter your password.
scripts.translation:
[庆典管理员]
我是“神SE”任务的庆典NPC管理员。
请输入您的密码。

scripts.text:
[Festival Manager]
Password is incorrect.
scripts.translation:
[庆典管理员]
密码错误。

scripts.text:
[Festival Manager]
What would you like to do?
scripts.translation:
[庆典管理员]
您想要做什么？

scripts.text: Disable festival NPCs
scripts.translation: 禁用庆典NPC

scripts.text: Enable festival NPCs
scripts.translation: 启用庆典NPC

scripts.text:
[Festival Manager]
Ending festivals and disabling NPCs.
scripts.translation:
[庆典管理员]
正在结束庆典并禁用NPC。

scripts.text:
[Festival Manager]
Resetting festivals and enabling NPCs.
scripts.translation:
[庆典管理员]
正在重置庆典并启用NPC。

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
A flower!!
Shall we proceed?
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉维斯]
一朵花！！
我们要继续吗？

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
Eeeeh, so young and yet you're a guild master? Your guildsmen must be jealous.
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉维斯]
哎呀，这么年轻就是公会会长了？你的公会成员一定很羡慕吧。

scripts.text:
[Reumimi Ravies]
I'm not sure if you understand the uses for that flower, so I'll briefly explain.
scripts.translation:
[雷乌米米·拉维斯]
我不确定你是否了解那朵花的用途，所以我简单解释一下。

scripts.text:
[Reumimi Ravies]
That flower has been passed down as a gift from the Valkyrie Wish Maiden herself.
It may be used to summon special monsters through summoners in special areas.
scripts.translation:
[雷乌米米·拉维斯]
那朵花是瓦尔基里许愿少女亲自赠送的礼物。
它可以在特定区域通过召唤师召唤特殊的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
There are only two summoners in existence who are capable of using that flower.
One is me, and the other is my twin sister Reumimi.
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉维斯]
世界上只有两位召唤师有能力使用那朵花。
一位是我，另一位是我的双胞胎姐妹雷乌米米。

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
Twin sisters, but we do not have much alike, little fingers in front of you ...
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉维斯]
虽然是双胞胎姐妹，但我们长得一点都不像，你看我伸出的小指...

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
..................................
.....Oops! I wasn't supposed to tell anyone...
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉维斯]
......
哎呀！我不该告诉别人的...

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
... Hehehe, anyways let's move on.
So do you wish to summon or not!?
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉维斯]
...呵呵呵，总之我们继续吧。
那么，你是想召唤，还是不想召唤呢！？

scripts.text: Do not summon
scripts.translation: 不召唤

scripts.text: Summon
scripts.translation: 召唤

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
...*Cries*.
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉维斯]
*哭泣*

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
If you've got no business with me, please don't start a conversation.
If it were my sister, she would've humiliated you for it.
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉维斯]
如果你没有正事，请不要跟我搭话。
要是我姐姐听到，肯定会让你难堪的。

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
Okay then, I'll explain a little about the summoning ritual.
Here in Juno, the summoning ritual through the use of that flower will summon Valkyrie's Blessing and Valkyrie's Gift.
The effects of the summoning ritual will last approximately one hour.
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉维斯]
好的，那我简单介绍一下召唤仪式。
在朱诺，使用那朵花进行召唤仪式，会召唤出天使之赐福和瓦尔基里的礼物。
召唤仪式的效果大约会持续一个小时。

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
During the summoning ritual, continuous broadcasts will be made.
It is a courtesy of the Valkyrie Wish Maiden, in order to unite adventurers from all over to participate in the festival.
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉维斯]
在召唤仪式期间，会进行连续的广播。
这是瓦尔基里许愿少女的善意，为了团结各地的冒险者共同参与节日。

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
Are you ready to begin the summoning ritual~?
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉维斯]
你准备好开始召唤仪式了吗~？

scripts.text: No, not yet.
scripts.translation: 不，还没准备好。

scripts.text: Yes! I'm ready!
scripts.translation: 是的！我准备好了！

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
You're not even ready, why bother talking to me?
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉维斯]
你还没准备好，为什么还要来找我？

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
Oh well, if you've got other things to do then I'll wait.
After all, that's also part of my job.
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉维斯]
好吧，如果你还有其他事要做，我就等着。
毕竟，这也是我工作的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
Very well, then I will check for a reasonable time to begin the summoning ritual.
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉维斯]
很好，那么我会确认一下开始召唤仪式的合适时间。

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
Good! Now seems like a good time, so let's begin!
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉维斯]
太好了！现在似乎是个好时机，我们开始吧！

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
I hope you enjoy yourself!
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉维斯]
祝你玩得尽兴！

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
*Cries*
It doesn't seem like now is a good time.
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉维斯]
*哭泣*
看来现在不是个好时机。

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
Please try again later.
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉维斯]
请稍后再试。

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
...Seems like you're not in a worthy position for me to talk to?
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉维斯]
...看来你还没有资格让我跟你说话？

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
I don't know how you obtained that flower, but if you're not capable of leading others.. then you cannot continue.
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉维斯]
我不知道你是怎么得到那朵花的，但如果你没有能力领导他人...那你就不能继续了。

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
Too tough?
Well, what can you do, that's part of the job.
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉维斯]
太难了？
那又怎样，这就是工作的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Rhehe Ravies]
Don't you have anything to give me to prove yourself?
scripts.translation:
[雷赫·拉维斯]
你难道就没有什么能证明自己的东西吗？
